_readme: Turkey/KKTC university-spine expansion candidates -- systematic pass via YOK Atlas (yokatlas.yok.gov.tr), Turkey's official national higher-education directory, covering every institution in YOK Atlas's own universiteler list (228 total) cross-referenced against ORYN's live universities table (12 Turkish universities in spine as of 2026-08-21, all 12 confirmed present in the raw 228 and excluded below). This is a DO-NOT-CREATE-ROWS candidate list per explicit coordinator instruction -- for a separate canonical-entity resolution pass, not for direct ingestion. institution_type (DEVLET=public/state, VAKIF=private/foundation, KKTC=Northern Cyprus) and city are YOK Atlas's own fields (universiteTuru, uniIlAdi), fetched live per-institution via the Tercih Sihirbazi search API, not inferred or guessed. lisans_program_count is each institution's own live Bachelor's-level (birimTuruId=46) result count at fetch time, useful as a rough size signal for prioritizing a future pass, not authoritative. official_domain is populated ONLY for the 9 institutions cross-verified against ROR (api.ror.org) this session or the prior new-institution-candidates_2026-08-21.json pass -- NOT resolved in bulk for the remaining 197 (that would need a per-institution ROR or site lookup each, out of scope for a single collection pass; flagged as follow-up work). Excluded from this list entirely: 4 vocational schools (Meslek Yuksekokulu -- Associate's/2-year only, not Bachelor's-granting) and 6 YOK-administered campuses physically located outside Turkey (Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, North Macedonia, Bosnia, Albania) -- see excluded_not_turkey_universities below, kept for completeness rather than silently dropped.
method: YOK Atlas Tercih Sihirbazi API (yokatlas.yok.gov.tr/api/tercih-kilavuz/universiteler for the full list; /search per-institution for type/city/count), cross-verified against 9 domains via api.ror.org (exact display-name matched, not top-search-result assumed -- see near_miss_caught note)
near_miss_caught: ROR's own search-relevance ranking put the WRONG institution first for 'Anadolu University' -- rank 0 was Usak University (a real, different, unrelated Turkish university, ror.org/05es91y67, domain usak.edu.tr), with the actual Anadolu University (ror.org/05nz37n09, domain anadolu.edu.tr) at rank 1. Caught by explicitly checking the returned display name against the query rather than trusting the top hit -- the same discipline the coordinator asked for after today's ITU/'Institute' substring-match and Sorbonne-alias near-misses. All 5 names verified this way before recording; none trusted on rank alone.
reconciliation_with_prior_ror_pass: This list supersedes and extends data/research/universities/new-institution-candidates_2026-08-21.json (a prior, smaller ROR-based pass) rather than duplicating it. That file's 4 ROR-verified candidates (Kadir Has, MEF, Istanbul Bilgi, Marmara) all appear in this YOK Atlas list too, cross-confirmed by two independent official sources. That file's 5 explicitly-unverified names (Gazi, Bahcesehir, TED, Galatasaray, Anadolu) have now been verified by both YOK Atlas (institution_type/city/program-count below) AND ROR (official_domain below) -- no longer unverified. The other 197 candidates below were not in that prior pass at all; this is a full systematic sweep, not a name-recall exercise.

candidates_turkey_mainland.domain_resolution_note: NOT CONFIDENTLY RESOLVED -- flagged rather than guessed. Top-4 ROR results were Istanbul Bilim University (istanbulbilim.edu.tr), Antalya Bilim University x2, and an unrelated 'Bilim Akademisi' -- none is an exact match for 'Demiroğlu Bilim Üniversitesi'. Likely explanation: this institution was formerly named 'İstanbul Bilim Üniversitesi' before a real-world rename (~2020-2021), so istanbulbilim.edu.tr may be a stale/former domain rather than the current one -- exactly the same class of rename-ambiguity as the Harita/Geomatik Mühendisliği case, and exactly the 'Bilim-family' collision risk flagged in advance. Not accepted without an actual site check.

A handful of accepted domains carry a disclosed caveat where ROR's own canonical display name is shorter than the institution's current official name (e.g. 'Muğla University' for the institution now officially named 'Muğla Sıtkı Koçman Üniversitesi') -- accepted on domain-pattern confidence with no competing candidate, but the discrepancy is recorded per-record in domain_verification_note rather than silently smoothed over.
